An owner or an admin set the rules for every harness, or turned every harness's asks off for a while (ADR 0299).

**Direction:** Chips → the log  
**Sent by:** a person  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`policy.workspace_updated.json`](/schema/policy.workspace_updated.json)

## Fields

Every event also carries the [envelope](/reference/envelope/).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | yes | `1` | Protocol major version. |
| `type` | yes | `"policy.workspace_updated"` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` | The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event. |
| `ts` | yes | `string` | When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `workspace_id` | yes | `string` | A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID. |
| `space_id` | no | `string` | The space, when the event belongs to one. |
| `run_id` | no | `string` | The run, when the event belongs to one. |
| `seq` | no | `number` | Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in. |
| `idempotency_key` | no | `string` | Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op. |
| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
| `actor.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent" \| "system"` | Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted. |
| `actor.id` | yes | `string` | The participant id, or `system` for Chips. |
| `actor.harness_id` | no | `string` | For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips. |
| `rules` | yes | object[] | Read before any harness's own, in order. Each rule a person adds is kept with who made it and when. |
| `rules[].match` | yes | `string` | A glob over action kinds, for example `payment.*`. |
| `rules[].when` | no | object | Extra conditions on the action's flags, and for a command, how its parts start. |
| `rules[].when.external` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `rules[].when.irreversible` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `rules[].when.money_usd_over` | no | `number` |  |
| `rules[].when.risk` | no | enum[] | One of `external`, `external_communication`, `irreversible`, `destructive`, `financial`, `credential`, `privacy`, `legal`. |
| `rules[].when.starts_with` | no | `string[]` | For an action that carries a command (ADR 0239): the words a part of it starts with. A command goes ahead on such rules only when every part starts with one that allows it. |
| `rules[].decision` | yes | `"allow" \| "ask" \| "deny"` | What to do when the rule matches. |
| `rules[].approvers` | no | `string[]` | Who may answer, when the decision is `ask`. |
| `rules[].reason` | no | `string` | Shown to the harness, and recorded in the audit log. |
| `rules[].off` | no | `boolean` | Turned off by a person (ADR 0195): kept in the list to turn back on, and skipped by the policy engine until then. |

| `changed_by` | yes | `string` | Who changed them. Filled in by Chips from the credential that sent it. |

  "hold": {
    "until": "2026-11-18T10:41:00.000Z",
    "by": "usr_01K4ZQPX000000000000000003",

  },
  "workspace_max_autonomy": 2,
  "changed_by": "usr_01K4ZQPX000000000000000003"
